implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosures are mandatory when acquirers cross 5%, 10%, 15%, 25%, 50% or 90% thresholds; this filing marks the formal regulatory gate and typically triggers a standstill period and open-offer obligation if threshold exceeds 25%—practitioners must model the triggering percentage and any exemptions (creeping acquisition, pledged shares, voting rights suspension).
